content:
Does CSLib have an ergonomic system for expressing that Lean computations have polylog depth circuits (NC)? I want it to show that the construction in https://github.com/girving/aks is in NC.

https://leanprover.zulipchat.com/#narrow/channel/113486-announce/topic/Seiferas's.20simplified.20O.28log.20n.29.20depth.20sorting.20networks/near/577912999
A formulation of NC is included in the repo linked here but none of this has been PRd to CSLib yet.
Hmm, importantly I’d want uniform circuits (I realise I just said circuits above), so maybe I need something different.

I have a free monad based dsl in cslib#372 (formerly cslib#275) to express multiple algorithmic models. I discovered that I could also encode circuits in it. The PR is currently sitting on ice because of … reasons beyond me (it should have been merged last week by any reasonable standard).
I already made an attempt to express circuits in it and succeeded. NC follows from this.
Essentially you can write one query type for TMs, another for circuits (use Nat id tags to identify equal nodes and gather and count all unique IDs in it for size )
I’d like to keep this thread free of a certain style of CSLib format debates. Shreyas: Would you be okay leaving this one to other commenters?
Sure. Feel free to build on the idea above.
